text: Artificial intelligence is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can produce paintings, compose music, and even write stories that look surprisingly human. Some people worry that machines will replace artists, but others see AI as a helpful tool—like a paintbrush or a keyboard—that can inspire new ideas. However, there is a key difference: human creativity comes from lived experience, emotion, and intuition, while machine creativity is based on patterns in data. AI can imitate styles, but it doesn’t truly understand meaning or feel passion. So, rather than competing, AI and humans might work together, combining imagination with endless possibilities.
